aiOverview.content: The Artemis II mission crew, announced by NASA in April 2023, consists of four astronauts scheduled to fly around the Moon. This crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (Commander), Victor Glover (Pilot), Christina Koch (Mission Specialist), and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist). Artemis II is the first crewed mission on NASA's path to establishing a long-term presence at the Moon.Reid Wiseman (Commander): A U.S. Navy pilot and former chief of the astronaut office, this is his second spaceflight.Victor Glover (Pilot): A U.S. Navy test pilot and engineer, he previously served on the first operational SpaceX Crew Dragon flight.Christina Koch (Mission Specialist): An engineer who holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist): A Royal Canadian Air Force fighter pilot and the first Canadian to have led a NASA astronaut class.Artemis II will serve as a 10-day test flight for the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft. The Artemis II mission crew, announced by NASA in April 2023, consists of four astronauts scheduled to fly around the Moon. This crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (Commander), Victor Glover (Pilot), Christina Koch (Mission Specialist), and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist). Artemis II is the first crewed mission on NASA's path to establishing a long-term presence at the Moon. Reid Wiseman (Commander): A U.S. Navy pilot and former chief of the astronaut office, this is his second spaceflight. Victor Glover (Pilot): A U.S. Navy test pilot and engineer, he previously served on the first operational SpaceX Crew Dragon flight. Christina Koch (Mission Specialist): An engineer who holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman. Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist): A Royal Canadian Air Force fighter pilot and the first Canadian to have led a NASA astronaut class. Artemis II will serve as a 10-day test flight for the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft.
